```{r}
school_names = c(
  "appstatesports"     = "App State",
  "astateredwolves"    = "Arkansas State",
  "goccusports"        = "Coastal Carolina",
  "gseagles"           = "Georgia Southern",
  "georgiastatesports" = "Georgia State",
  "jmusports"          = "James Madison",
  "ragincajuns"        = "Louisiana",
  "ulmwarhawks"        = "ULM",
  "latechsports"       = "Louisiana Tech",
  "herdzone"           = "Marshall",
  "odusports"          = "Old Dominion",
  "usajaguars"         = "South Alabama",
  "southernmiss"       = "Southern Miss",
  "troytrojans"        = "Troy"
)

urls = c(
  "https://gseagles.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://ragincajuns.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://herdzone.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://southernmiss.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://latechsports.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://troytrojans.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://goccusports.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://jmusports.com/sports/football/roster"
)

roster_function = function(roster_url){
  webpage = rvest::read_html(roster_url)
  
  # Get player cards first
  webpage |> rvest::html_elements(".s-person-card") -> cards
  
  # Names
  cards |> rvest::html_element("h3") |> rvest::html_text2() -> names
  
  # Position
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats-item:nth-child(1)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> position
  position = stringr::str_remove(position, "Position ")
  
  # Year
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats-item:nth-child(2)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> year
  year = stringr::str_remove(year, "Academic Year ")
  
  # Height
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats-item:nth-child(3)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> height
  height = stringr::str_remove(height, "Height ")
  
  # Weight
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats-item:nth-child(4)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> weight
  weight = stringr::str_remove(weight, "Weight ")
  weight = stringr::str_remove(weight, " lbs")
  
  # Hometown
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-card__content__person__location-item") |> rvest::html_text2() -> hometown
  hometown = stringr::str_remove(hometown, "Hometown")
  split_home = stringr::str_split_fixed(hometown, ",", n = 2)
  city  = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 1])
  state = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 2])
  
  # Previous school
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-card__content__person__previous-school-item") |> rvest::html_text2() -> prev_school
  prev_school = stringr::str_squish(prev_school)
  prev_school = stringr::str_remove(prev_school, "^.*Previous School(\\(s\\))?:\\s*")
  
  # Current school
  site = stringr::str_extract(roster_url, "(?<=://)[^.]+")
  school = unname(school_names[site])
  
  # Make the data frame
  df = data.frame(school = school, name = names, year = year, position = position,
                  height = height, weight_lbs = weight,
                  hometown_city = city, hometown_state = state,
                  previous_school = prev_school)
  
  # Drop coach/staff cards (no listed position)
  df = df[!is.na(df$position), ]
  
  return(df)
}

sunbelt_df = data.frame()
for (url in urls) {
  df = roster_function(roster_url = url)
  
  sunbelt_df = rbind(sunbelt_df, df)
  
  Sys.sleep(2)
}
```
```{r}
urls2 = c(
  "https://appstatesports.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://astateredwolves.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://georgiastatesports.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://usajaguars.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://ulmwarhawks.com/sports/football/roster"
)

roster_function2 = function(roster_url){
  webpage = rvest::read_html(roster_url)
  
  # Get player cards first
  webpage |> rvest::html_elements(".sidearm-roster-player") -> cards
  
  # Names
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".sidearm-roster-player-name > h3 > a") |> rvest::html_text2() -> names
  
  # Position
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".sidearm-roster-player-position") |> rvest::html_text2() -> position
  
  # Year
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".sidearm-roster-player-academic-year") |> rvest::html_text2() -> year
  
  # Height
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".sidearm-roster-player-height") |> rvest::html_text2() -> height
  
  # Weight
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".sidearm-roster-player-weight") |> rvest::html_text2() -> weight
  weight = stringr::str_remove(weight, " lbs")
  
  # Hometown
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".sidearm-roster-player-hometown") |> rvest::html_text2() -> hometown
  split_home = stringr::str_split_fixed(hometown, ",", n = 2)
  city  = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 1])
  state = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 2])
  
  # Previous school
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".sidearm-roster-player-previous-school") |> rvest::html_text2() -> prev_school
  prev_school = stringr::str_squish(prev_school)
  
  # Current school
  site = stringr::str_extract(roster_url, "(?<=://)[^.]+")
  school = unname(school_names[site])
  
  # Make the data frame
  df = data.frame(school = school, name = names, year = year, position = position,
                  height = height, weight_lbs = weight,
                  hometown_city = city, hometown_state = state,
                  previous_school = prev_school)
  
  df = df[!is.na(df$position), ]
  
  return(df)
}

for (url in urls2) {
  df = roster_function2(roster_url = url)
  
  sunbelt_df = rbind(sunbelt_df, df)
  
  Sys.sleep(2)
}
```

# For Old Dominion

od_url = paste0("https://odusports.com/sports/football/roster")
webpage = rvest::read_html(od_url)

# Names
webpage |> rvest::html_elements("div > a > span") |> rvest::html_text2() -> names
names = names[3:112]

# Position
webpage |> rvest::html_elements(".roster-table-cell--player-position-name > span") |> rvest::html_text2() -> position

# Year
webpage |> rvest::html_elements(".roster-table-cell--class-level-name > span") |> rvest::html_text2() -> year

# Height
webpage |> rvest::html_elements(".roster-table-cell--height-text > span") |> rvest::html_text2() -> height

# Weight
webpage |> rvest::html_elements(".roster-table-cell--weight-text > span") |> rvest::html_text2() -> weight
weight = stringr::str_remove(weight, " lbs")

# Hometown
webpage |> rvest::html_elements(".roster-table-cell--hometown > span") |> rvest::html_text2() -> hometown
split_home = stringr::str_split_fixed(hometown, ",", n = 2)
city  = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 1])
state = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 2])

# Previous school
webpage |> rvest::html_elements(".roster-table-cell--previous-school > span") |> rvest::html_text2() -> prev_school
prev_school = stringr::str_squish(prev_school)

# Current school
school = "Old Dominion"

# Make the data frame
df = data.frame(school = school, name = names, year = year, position = position,
                height = height, weight_lbs = weight,
                hometown_city = city, hometown_state = state,
                previous_school = prev_school)

sunbelt_df = rbind(sunbelt_df, df)
